description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SavingsOfficerUnassignmentException' used in the savings account module to signal that a savings account is not assigned to any officer.

classes.name: SavingsOfficerUnassignmentException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a savings account is not assigned to any savings officer, extending a general platform domain rule exception.

methods.name: SavingsOfficerUnassignmentException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with an account ID and a specific error message indicating the account is unassigned.
